slug: 2024-09-25 Raxio launches CIV1 data centre in Abidjan (Cote d'Ivoire)

facts.fact: Raxio Group launched CIV1, a carrier-neutral data centre at VITIB near Abidjan, in September 2024, as reported by Data Center Dynamics.
Raxio CIV1 at VITIB (Abidjan area), launched September 2024, is described by Data Center Dynamics as a Tier III carrier-neutral facility; the basis of the Tier III claim is not stated.
